install_apk: install an APK on an Android device from a filesystem path or binary blob using adb
start_activity: start an Android activity by its full class name with optional force stop and extra args
tap_and_press_button: simulate a tap at coordinates or press a hardware button like HOME, BACK, or ENTER
manage_settings: get, put, delete, reset, or list Android system, secure, or global settings via adb shell
list_packages_and_features: list installed packages, device features, or shared libraries using the Android package manager
